title: PostgreSQL outbox and inbox delivery
alt: PostgreSQL transaction flow. A caller commits domain state and an outbox event together. A caller-driven relay publishes leased events and uses a fencing token for acknowledgment. A consumer admits a receipt with its domain effects and acknowledges after commit.
